written_by_hand: This run was made on a hosted notebook that holds no copy of the repository, so record_run.py could not record it. The manifest is assembled here from what the notebook returned; node.json is the scorer's own account of its environment and its cells, and score.log is its console output.
host: Google Colab, free tier, Linux x86_64, Python 3.13.15
gpu: NVIDIA Tesla T4, 15.64 GB, CUDA 12.8, torch 2.11.0+cu128
command: python score_context.py 2026-09-05-lc-2015h1e-bundle --out-dir 2026-09-05-lc-2015h1e-bundle-scored --models tabicl --nearest 3 --seeds 20260911 --chunk 20000, from the unpacked job archive

job_archive.built_by: assembled by hand from scripts/score_context.py and the bundle directory of experiments/2026-09-05-lc-2015h1e-bundle, as a zip for the notebook's upload cell
job_archive.score_context_py_provenance: Hash of the copy inside the archive, already LF-ended; equal to scripts/score_context.py in this tree and to the copy that ran on the M4 Pro (experiments/2026-09-06-lc-2015h1e-tabpfn-m4pro), unchanged since commit 6ff4872.

result_archive.name: outoftime-result-tabicl-2026-09-05-lc-2015h1e-bundle.zip
result_archive.contents: 2026-09-05-lc-2015h1e-bundle-scored/ (node.json, scores.parquet, reference.parquet, parts/) and score.log, copied here unchanged

bundle_check.how: The hashes the scorer recorded in node.json for the bundle it read, equal to the files of experiments/2026-09-05-lc-2015h1e-bundle on this machine and to the hashes the M4 Pro run recorded. The scorer refuses a bundle whose hashes differ from bundle.json, so the notebook scored the recorded rows.

row_check.scored: 60,000 rows over 2015Q3, 2015Q4, 2016Q1; every (cohort, row) pair and its outcome and age match the gbm rows of experiments/2026-09-05-lc-2015h1e-scores/scores.parquet, zero mismatches; no missing probability
row_check.reference: 50,000 rows; every row and its outcome match the gbm-50k reference of context seed 20260911 in experiments/2026-09-05-lc-2015h1e-scores/reference.parquet, zero mismatches; realised rate 2.248%

console_log: score.log is included. It is the scorer's own summary plus the checkpoint download notice; it was read in full and holds no home path, no account name and no token.
question_this_run_was_sent_to_answer: The TabICL side of the cheapest falsifying run of EXP-002: the same build (2015H1-E), the same context seed and the same three cohorts as experiments/2026-09-06-lc-2015h1e-tabpfn-m4pro, so that the two foundation models can be read against the classical intervals of experiments/2026-09-05-lc-2015h1e-intervals2 on identical rows.

what_it_measured.model: tabicl 2.1.1, checkpoint tabicl-classifier-v2-20260212.ckpt (sha256 bdc7dbd5...4ed0) downloaded from Hugging Face by the library, tabpfn not installed
what_it_measured.context: 50,000 rows of seed 20260911; every parameter at its default (node.json): n_estimators 8, softmax_temperature 0.9, random_state 42, average_logits true; categorical columns passed as object dtype and not declared, since the estimator takes no categorical index
what_it_measured.chunk: 20,000 scored rows per forward call (--chunk 20000), so the 50,000-row reference cell ran in three calls; rows are scored independently and the chunking changes no probability
what_it_measured.repeat: 2015Q3 scored twice from a fresh fit: largest absolute disagreement 0.0, no row differs

tuning_budget: Added 2026-09-06 after the seventh cold audit, which found the baseline gate's budget statement missing from the run manifests. TabICL: zero trials, no validation split, every parameter at the library default (node.json params: n_estimators 8, softmax_temperature 0.9). The classical models it is paired with were tuned on their own pool (build.json of experiments/2026-09-05-lc-2015h1e-scores), and the asymmetry runs both ways: the foundation model gets no tuning, the 50,000-row control inherits the point chosen on the 323,026-row pool.
against_the_memory_law: experiments/2026-08-30-colab-t4-memory-law measured 11.35 GB at a 50,000-row context on the same GPU and library version; this run peaked at 10.97 GB with 20,000 rows per call.
not_in_this_run: TabPFN. Its side of the falsifying run is experiments/2026-09-06-lc-2015h1e-tabpfn-m4pro, from the same bundle.
